package.name: l5_policy
package.description: L5 canary for the learned-residual path (tests/l5_policy): racer_control tracker_node in handoff mode, racer_policy policy_node and racer_safety safety_node on the real command path, on a family stadium, both directions, ground-truth pose, compared with the tracker alone. Uses tests/l5_reactive_bench/track_family_runner.py (driver tracker_policy) and a small fixture TorchScript network, so it needs torch (skipped without it).
